description: This PHP source file defines the ViewDropdown class, which manages the display and generation of a Smarty template for dropdown menus in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder interface. It includes methods for handling AJAX responses, rendering the Smarty template with list strings, and processing user input for creating or editing dropdowns.

classes.name: ViewDropdown
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that handles AJAX dropdown menu operations within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder interface, including rendering templates and managing dropdown definitions.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the module title parameters for display, including translated module name and module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the display of the dropdown management interface, including AJAX sections and Smarty template rendering.

methods.name: generateSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and returns a configured Smarty object with data for creating or editing a dropdown menu.
